legend: Monocarp has drawn a tree (an undirected connected acyclic graph) and then has given each vertex an index. All indices are distinct numbers from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$. For every edge e$$$e$$$ of this tree, Monocarp has written two numbers: the maximum indices of the vertices of the two components formed if the edge e$$$e$$$ (and only this edge) is erased from the tree.

Monocarp has given you a list of n−1$$$n - 1$$$ pairs of numbers. He wants you to provide an example of a tree that will produce the said list if this tree exists. If such tree does not exist, say so.
input: The first line contains one integer n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤1000$$$2 \le n \le 1\,000$$$) — the number of vertices in the tree.

Each of the next n−1$$$n-1$$$ lines contains two integers ai$$$a_i$$$ and bi$$$b_i$$$ each (1≤ai<bi≤n$$$1 \le a_i  \lt  b_i \le n$$$) — the maximal indices of vertices in the components formed if the i$$$i$$$-th edge is removed.
output: If there is no such tree that can produce the given list of pairs, print "NO" (without quotes).

Otherwise print "YES" (without quotes) in the first line and the edges of the tree in the next n−1$$$n - 1$$$ lines. Each of the last n−1$$$n - 1$$$ lines should contain two integers xi$$$x_i$$$ and yi$$$y_i$$$ (1≤xi,yi≤n$$$1 \le x_i, y_i \le n$$$) — vertices connected by an edge.

Note: The numeration of edges doesn't matter for this task. Your solution will be considered correct if your tree produces the same pairs as given in the input file (possibly reordered). That means that you can print the edges of the tree you reconstructed in any order.
note: Possible tree from the first example. Dotted lines show edges you need to remove to get appropriate pairs.

legend.ai: Monocarp 画了一棵树(一个无向连通无环图)，然后为每个顶点赋予了一个编号。所有编号都是从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$ 的互不相同的数。对于这棵树的每条边 e$$$e$$$，Monocarp 都写下了两个数：如果从树中删去边 e$$$e$$$(且仅删去这条边)后形成的两个连通分量中，各自顶点编号的最大值。
Monocarp 给了你一个包含 n−1$$$n - 1$$$ 对数字的列表。他希望你在存在这样的树时，给出一棵能够生成上述列表的树作为示例。如果不存在这样的树，请说明这一点。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(2≤n≤1000$$$2 \le n \le 1\,000$$$)——树中顶点的数量。
接下来的 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 行中的每一行包含两个整数 ai$$$a_i$$$ 和 bi$$$b_i$$$(1≤ai<bi≤n$$$1 \le a_i  \lt  b_i \le n$$$)——删除第 i$$$i$$$ 条边后形成的各个连通分量中顶点编号的最大值。

output.ai: 如果不存在能够生成给定数对列表的树，输出“NO”（不含引号）。
否则，第一行输出“YES”(不含引号)，接下来的 n−1$$$n - 1$$$ 行输出树的边。后 n−1$$$n - 1$$$ 行中的每一行应包含两个整数 xi$$$x_i$$$ 和 yi$$$y_i$$$(1≤xi,yi≤n$$$1 \le x_i, y_i \le n$$$)——由一条边相连的顶点。
注意：在本题中，边的编号并不重要。如果你的树生成的数对与输入文件中给出的数对相同（可能顺序不同），则你的解法将被视为正确。这意味着，你可以按任意顺序输出重建出的树的边。

note.ai: 第一个样例中的一种可能的树。虚线表示为了得到合适的配对而需要删除的边。
